purpose: Execute the corrected three-branch frequency logic after reverse audit: H0 source-frequency-invariant 117-121 Hz, H1 wavelength-equivalent speed-dependent ~520 Hz class, and H2 fluid-loaded structural resonance without simple speed-ratio scaling.

H2.name: FLUID_LOADED_STRUCTURAL_MODE
H2.rule: No direct 119-to-520 scaling; require geometry, material properties, water loading, damping and boundary conditions or a measured transfer function.

sensor_recording_existence.evidence: Parnell-Turner et al. 2022 report equatorial Atlantic hydrophone waveforms recorded 2011-08-10 to 2015-01-13 at 16-bit resolution and 250 Hz sampling; HA10 Ascension data were also recorded at 250 Hz.
sensor_recording_existence.warning: Band is close to Nyquist; instrument response and anti-alias roll-off must be recovered before quantitative amplitude comparison, especially at 121 Hz.

public_product.dataset: T-phase location catalog for equatorial Atlantic ocean, 2011-2015
public_product.meaning: Public event positions/times exist, but this product is not waveform audio/time-series and therefore cannot be Fourier-scanned for 119 Hz.

direct_public_waveform_bytes.evidence: The paper's Data Availability Statement points to the MGDS T-phase catalog; it does not expose the full waveform corpus as an anonymous public download.

conditions: raw IMS data may not be redistributed

spectral_scan_execution.reason: A catalog of event origins cannot establish whether a discrete 119.000 Hz line exists in the original pressure waveforms. No synthetic replacement is permitted.
spectral_scan_execution.interpretation: ZERO_VERIFIED does not mean ZERO_EXISTS; the scan has not yet had the necessary waveform bytes.

nominal_520_controls.reason: Published harmonic description uses integer-Hz fundamental/spacing and iceberg harmonic tremor fundamentals are time-variable; no uncertainty supports sub-Hz identity.

fingerprint.modal_spacing: YES__approximately 40 Hz harmonic spacing in the cited example
fingerprint.long_duration: YES__iceberg harmonic tremor can persist for long periods
fingerprint.earth_fixed_geodetic_focus: NO__iceberg is a moving natural source

nominal_520_controls.reason: The same device shifted 10 Hz between FE prediction and wet measurement, far exceeding the 0.408163 Hz difference from the H1 nominal center; no reported uncertainty justifies sub-Hz exactness.

H1_full_fingerprint_discrimination.reason: The strongest 520-class hits are controls with known natural or engineered explanations and incomplete target-transfer observables.

H2_fluid_loaded_structural_gate.reason: No candidate geometry/material/local complex return is established at the frozen anchor from which a wet structural eigenmode can be independently predicted or inverted.
required_inputs: water density and local sound-speed profile
measured or simulated complex transfer function for validation
